meta.redesign: Drafting (blueprint) direction chosen from the Forge directions canvas; values no longer mirror the code

color.note: A drawing in white line on a cyanotype wash, or in Prussian-blue ink on vellum. Lines and the grid are translucent so they sit on the ground; sheets, the chrome and every filled control are opaque, so the grid and paper show only on the ground. Text and ink are opaque.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The sheet: a cyanotype wash, or vellum drafting paper. Ruled with the 8/64px grid and dusted with the paper fibre (assets/Textures/paper.svg) on every full-page ground; dialogs sit on a plain `bg`.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: The exposure falloff at the sheet's corners and the shadow of the drawer and dialogs.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A sheet’s opaque fill, one step from the ground toward the theme’s highest-contrast colour (darker on cyanotype, lighter on vellum): cards, KPI tiles, table wrappers, the drawer, dialogs, the command bar, toasts. The grid and paper never show through it. `fg` is 11.04:1 on it on cyanotype, 11.62:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The active nav item, the active tab, a pressed secondary button, hovered table rows.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The sidebar and the phone header: opaque, the furthest step from the ground, with a `line-strong` edge and `shadow-chrome`. `fg` is 13.14:1 on it on cyanotype, 12.12:1 on vellum; the weakest text pair, `redline` on chrome under `sketch-line`, is 5.63:1 / `ok` 4.86:1.

tokens.name: sketch-line
tokens.usage: The hover sketch: 1px lines at 45° every `hatch-pitch`, drawn over a hovered control’s own opaque fill. Every text token stays at 4.5:1 or more on panel + sketch (weakest 4.78:1 cyanotype, 4.67:1 vellum) and on chrome + sketch.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Linework: sheet outlines, table rules, dividers, input borders, dimension lines, dashed container borders.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hatching (hover, emphasis, the live chip), construction geometry inside icons, the hard offset shadow under primary buttons.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Corner register ticks, the active nav rule, focused control borders, the ends of dimension lines, the 3px active tab marker.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: The 8px grid on the ground.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: The 64px grid on the ground; cards and columns align to it.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `panel` and `raised`: titles, body, values, the active item. 9.4:1 on cyanotype, 10.5:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, ids, dims, counts, inactive nav items and tabs. 6.0:1 on cyanotype, 5.3:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Placeholders, the title block's keys, disabled text. 3.7:1 on cyanotype and 2.5:1 on vellum: never for copy a person must read.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Full-strength drawing ink: primary button fills, the active nav rule, progress fills, selected segments, the live-agent dot. White on cyanotype, Prussian blue on vellum.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill (`.btn.primary`, a selected segment, the pressed state).

tokens.name: redline
tokens.usage: Markup red: REV tags, the dashed outline of a job that needs a human, failed jobs, CHANGES verdicts, rejected requests, error toasts, the settings tab error dot. On bg / panel / panel + raised: 5.9 / 7.0 / 5.4:1 on cyanotype, 5.6 / 6.3 / 5.5:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marker yellow: unsaved-change dots, the held and waiting counts, `::selection`. A fill under `#14355f` text, never text itself on vellum.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: PASS verdicts, merged PRs, done sessions, the active-sessions dot, healthy budgets. 6.6:1 on cyanotype, 5.3:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and chips (held, waiting, over budget): the highlight hue on cyanotype, an ochre that reads on paper. On bg / panel / panel + raised: 7.3 / 8.5 / 6.6:1 on cyanotype, 5.3 / 5.9 / 5.2:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failure text and chips; the same hue as `redline`, kept as its own token so status and markup can diverge later. On bg / panel / panel + raised: 5.9 / 7.0 / 5.4:1 on cyanotype, 5.6 / 6.3 / 5.5:1 on vellum.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: a non-feature `kind` chip, subagent blocks in the session log, links inside body copy. 6.4:1 / 5.5:1.

families.head: "Space Grotesk", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The system's own name and a view's hero moment only. Letter-spacing -0.01em.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The `h1` of every view (`PageHeader`), with a dimension line beneath it instead of a subtitle.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: The job drawer's title, the settings dialog title, `h1` in rendered markdown.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: `h2` in rendered markdown; the title of a sheet that groups controls.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Job card titles (two lines max), table-row titles, thread sender names, the brand word at 22px.
styles.sample: Sync the design system from the GitHub repository

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default UI size: card copy, descriptions, settings rows, table cells, dialog text.

styles.name: body-prose
styles.usage: Rendered markdown (`.prose`): spec files, notes, docs in the drawer.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timeline events, fact labels' values, footnotes, the dims under KPI values.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar and settings-rail items, tabs: uppercase, letter-spacing .06em.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, chips: uppercase, letter-spacing .08em.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section callouts, KPI labels, table headers, fact labels, card footers: uppercase, letter-spacing .12em, `muted`.

styles.name: dim
styles.usage: Dimension-line text, the title block, keyboard hints: uppercase, letter-spacing .08em.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Ids, refs, branches, verbs, paths, inline code; `muted` under a title, `fg` in a fact.

styles.name: mono-log
styles.usage: Session log lines; turn headings at 600.

styles.name: kpi-value
styles.usage: KPI tile values and the drawer's totals, tabular numerals.

spacing.note: An 8px drafting grid with a 64px major; the half steps exist for chips and the sketch only.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: chip padding-y, the gap between a label and its dimension line.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and chip rows; the grid's half step.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Chip padding-x, button icon gaps, the sketch pitch, status dots.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The grid step and the resting gap inside a sheet: chip rows, fact grids, thread items, control padding-y, table cell padding-y.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Segmented-control and input padding-x, the daemon bar's padding-y, the sidebar brand gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and table-cell padding-x, job-card padding, board-column gaps, the title block's cell padding plus a hair.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sheet and KPI padding, banners and toasts, page gutters on phones, dialog header padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Drawer padding on phones, the gap between drawer sections, the space under a page header.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Drawer and dialog padding at md+, page bottom padding, the gap between analytics blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters at md+ (four grid steps).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding-y; the mark in empty states.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Touch targets on phones: icon buttons, the header's command and settings buttons.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The major grid; column widths and the sidebar's inner rhythm are multiples of it.

size.note: Fixed widths the layout relies on.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Nav and rail icons; 15px inside buttons, 26px on specimen sheets.

tokens.name: size-mark
tokens.usage: The Forge mark in the sidebar brand sheet.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: The desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: size-settings-rail
tokens.usage: The settings dialog's tab rail at md+.

tokens.name: size-board-column
tokens.usage: A pipeline board column (276 + 12 gap = 288, 4.5 major steps).

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: The main column's maximum width.

tokens.name: size-drawer-max
tokens.usage: The job drawer's maximum width.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: The settings dialog at md+; the command bar is 672px.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything drawn: sheets, buttons, inputs, chips, tabs, dialogs, the drawer. A drafting has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots, radio buttons, the ok/live indicators.

shadow.note: Hard offsets, never blur: a second sheet behind the first.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: The hard offset under `.btn.primary`; grows to 4px and `line` on hover, collapses to 0 when pressed. No blur anywhere in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: A second sheet behind the settings dialog and the command bar, offset like a stack of drawings.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The job drawer's left edge: the same stacked-sheet offset, leftwards.

tokens.name: shadow-chrome
tokens.usage: The desktop sidebar’s right edge: a hard 8px offset painted over the main column (the sidebar sits at z-10, under the drawer and dialogs).

drafting.note: The drawing conventions: pitches, strokes and marks the stylesheet reads.

tokens.name: hatch-pitch
tokens.usage: The sketch’s pitch: 1px `sketch-line` lines at 45° every 6px, drawn on a hovered control and animated in over 160 ms.

tokens.name: grid-minor-step
tokens.usage: The fine grid on the ground.

tokens.name: grid-major-step
tokens.usage: The heavy grid on the ground.

tokens.name: tick
tokens.usage: Corner register marks on sheets: 1px `line-strong`, L-shaped, at all four corners.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke; construction geometry at 60% opacity, dashed 2/2.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Every drawn line. Nothing in the system is thicker than 1px except the 3px active marker.

tokens.name: dash
tokens.usage: The dashed outline of containers (board columns, the ⌘K button) and of focus rings (1px, offset 2–3px).

tokens.name: paper-opacity
tokens.usage: The fibre overlay's opacity on cyanotype, soft-light blend; 0.55 multiply on vellum.
